title: Price Disclosure → Collector Intent
interpretation: No production telemetry events were recorded after the official baseline reset.
Because both variants had zero page-view sessions, the primary confirmation rate is undefined for both variants.
No conclusion can be made about whether upfront price disclosure increases, decreases, or does not change collector intent.

Prelaunch CONTROL/TREATMENT telemetry validation had passed before the launch reset, so the experiment instrumentation was validated at launch; however, zero production events cannot by itself distinguish zero real visits from a post-launch availability or delivery issue.
prohibited_claims: Do not claim CONTROL is better.
Do not claim TREATMENT is better.
Do not claim the proposed 0.01 ETH price was accepted or rejected by visitors.
next_step: EXP-009 should test distribution/traffic acquisition first, before another pricing or collector-intent variable.
